_what: Tunables read by src/audience-sends.mjs. most_channel_attempts is how many times one channel may be tried for one person: a channel that answered no is tried again by a later run until it has been tried this many times, and a channel whose road threw is never tried again, since it may have gone out. retry_after_seconds is when the run that retries those channels is scheduled, when no further page is left to run.

words.needs_record: Choose what to send: a sales contract or any record you can share (record).
words.needs_audience: Choose who gets it: a list, people by name and address, or the people an earlier send reached.
words.bad_channel: {channel} is not a way to send. Choose from {channels}, or name a Workshop tool as { road: "tool", tool_id }.
words.bad_timing: when is manual (kept until run), now, at (with a time) or each_new (each new person who joins the list).
words.each_new_needs_list: Each new person who joins needs a list to watch.
words.bad_until: until is the time each person's link stops opening, in the future, like 2026-10-05T09:00:00Z.
words.bad_can: can is a list of what each link lets its person do, like ["view", "run"].
words.bad_time: at must be a time in the future, like 2026-10-05T09:00:00Z.
words.bad_prices: prices are 2 to {most} amounts in cents, like [4000, 6000]; one price needs no list.
words.prices_need_contract: Two prices need a priced sales contract to send.
words.bad_source: Audience item {index} is { list_id, view_id?, rules? }, { people: [{ name?, email?, phone? }] } or { send_id, state }.
words.stopped: This send was stopped, so nothing more goes out.
words.asked_not_to: They asked not to get these.
words.text_not_carried: Text needs your Mac or phone awake with Messages or WhatsApp connected.
words.operation: Choose an operation: save, run, results, stop, list, read or do_not_send.
